CLAIM 0.010204","counterconditions":[{"case":"Any three points in the construction are collinear, resulting in a triangle area of 0.0.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The minimum triangle area is less than 0.005, failing the floor criterion.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The points provided are not distinct or fall outside the [0,1]x[0,1] bounds.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Eight points are evenly spaced along the left edge of the unit square and five points are evenly spaced along the bottom portion of the right edge. The minimum triangle area is formed by taking two adjacent points on one edge and one point directly across on the opposite edge. The height of such a triangle is 1.0 (the width of the square) and the base is 1/7. The area is 1/2 * (1/7) * 1 = 1/14 ≈ 0.071428, but the construction as stated carefully avoids three points being collinear across the two different edges, so the minimum triangle is actually formed by two points on one edge and one on the other. Wait, if all 8 points are on the left edge and 5 on the right edge, any 3 points chosen from the same edge are collinear and form a zero-area triangle, meaning the minimum triangle area is exactly 0.0.
